name: Turn one science or history idea into a short narrated animation
tagline: Type a concept and get a cinematic educational clip with voiceover
description: Fogsight is a browser tool that turns a single idea - a physics law, a historical event, a maths idea - into a short educational animation with cinematic visuals and narration in English or Chinese. Describe the topic in a sentence, let it draft the storyboard and visuals, then watch or share the clip. A free trial is available; paid plans are listed on the pricing page.
